Annexure II SCOPE OF WORK FOR VARIOUS SETUP ARRANGEMENT FOR ANNUAL CONVOCATION CEREMONY 2026 TO BE HELD AT INDIAN INSTITUTE OF PACKAGING MUMBAI. Preamble: 1. Convocation event of the Institute to be held at IIP Mumbai on 11.12.2026. In case of any change in the schedule – date and time of the convocation event, bidders will be intimate d about the same and the bidders will have to adjust their work program within a short no tice depending upon the revised program schedule. 2. High-level dignitaries are expected to attend the convocation ceremony. Hence, the bid ders should be prepared to take care of any exigency such as introduction of additional re quirement/s, infrastructure for protocol & security arrangement, shifting of venue etc. as and when required. 3. The infrastructure to be created for holding the event should be of the highest standard co mmiserating to the expectations of an event being presided over by Govt.of India. 4. The venue for the convocation ceremony and any other arrangement/s or additional infrastr ucture to be arranged at IIP Mumbai, Plot E2, MIDC Area, Andheri East, Road No.8, Post Box No. 9432, Mumbai 400093, Maharashtra.

Brief of the scope of work is mentioned below. A. At Event Lawn (Main Venue): 1. Stage preparation such as · Fixing of Backdrop (LED) screen. · Chairs & Tables on the dais · Podium with microphone – 4 Nos. (2 each) · Carpet of entire stage · Air Coolers · Stage lighting · Stage Monitor (Both for sound & display) · Flower decoration for the back drop, tables, podiums, front elevation of the stag e & 10 nos. of bouquets · Lighting decoration. 2. Seating arrangement for students / VIPs such as · Two rows of 03-seater high quality sofa on the Lawn · 25 Rows of cushioned chairs with cloth covered. 20 chairs in each row (moving s pace of 6 feet in between and at side). · Sound system 3. Flower decoration at entrance gate and at the steps. 4. Power arrangements/ back‐up through two DG (Diesel Generator) sets each of 65 KVA. 5. Provision for electric connection including extension boards. B. Buffet System Arrangement near event lawn 1. For hosting lunch following arrangements are to be made · Tent for serving area with at least 10 nos. serving counters · Provision for water & electric connection including extension boards · Hand wash facility · Lights and fans · Canopy type structure tent (roof with tarpaulin and proper air circulation) for cooki ng space with light & power arrangement. C. Other Scope: 1. Erection of box type entrance gate near IIP gate, welcome banners of various sizes of flex material fixed on frames, direction board. 2. Light decoration of venue and other additional infrastructure. 3. Light decoration of Main building & main Gate. 4. Flower decoration of Main Gate & Venue. 5. Sound for Packfest on 08th, 09th & 10th December, 2026. 6. Stage – 12 x 16 ft for Packfest on 08th, 09th & 10th December, 2026. 7. The theme for banners & backdrop will be given by the IIP, but the final art work as per site requirement is under the scope of the vendor. 8. Obtaining all the necessary clearance/licenses from local authorities. 9. The IIP should execute any additional non‐BOQ work as per the site requirement. Payment will be made as per market rate analysis mutually agreed by the vendor and IIP. 10. The deviation in the BOQ items is allowed to any limit as per the site requir ement and rate revision is not permissible in this case.
The setup should be cleared to make the site at IIP Mumbai as previous after the completion of the e vent.
